FAILED as shipped: _broker_config_resource only probes top-level kafka.ConfigResource/ConfigResourceType and the kafka.admin.config_resource submodule attribute, but kafka-python 3.0.11 re-exports them at kafka.admin (from kafka.admin import ConfigResource, ConfigResourceType works). After an in-process corrected lookup, a second mismatch surfaced: the connector expects describe_configs() to return a futures dict keyed by ConfigResource, but kafka-python 3.x returns a resolved nested dict {resource_type: {resource_name: {key: {value,...}}}}. With both corrected at runtime the live read WORKS against the real broker: 314 config entries for broker 1 incl. log.dirs='/root/kafka-pilot/kraft-combined-logs', num.partitions=1, auto.create.topics.enable=true. Repo fake-transport tests mock the old futures API, so they cannot catch this.

notes: Live validation against real Apache Kafka 3.9.1 (KRaft, single combined broker+controller node, PLAINTEXT on 127.0.0.1:9092/9093, kafka-python 3.0.11 driver, connector instantiated with security_protocol='PLAINTEXT' — SASL is opt-in only, no limitation). Driver installed via pip (--break-system-packages). Topic 'rca-test' (1 partition) seeded with 10 key=value messages (k1..k10=v1..v10), verified present via kafka-console-consumer before connector reads. 6/7 read checks passed against real broker state. ONE REAL FINDING: get_kafka_broker_config is broken against kafka-python 3.x (wrong ConfigResource lookup location + stale futures-API assumption in describe_configs handling); the underlying read was proven to work live once corrected at runtime (314 entries). Recommend a connector fix: import ConfigResource/ConfigResourceType from kafka.admin and parse describe_configs' resolved-dict return. SANDBOX GOTCHAS (for other workers): /tmp is a 512M tmpfs shared across workers (do not fill; relocate large payloads to the root fs), and 'localhost' resolving to ::1 breaks the broker<->controller channel (garbage frame -> JVM OOM loop); fix is controller.quorum.voters=1@127.0.0.1:9093 plus -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true. Read-only connector use only; restart_consumer (privileged) never called. Kafka stopped after validation; payload left at /root/kafka-pilot for reuse. Broker log at /root/kafka-pilot/kafka.log.
